limits.en: Community Edition: free, self-hosted, source-available on GitHub, unlimited workflows

keyLimits.en: Self-hosted, source-available; unlimited users and workflows but no cloud infrastructure or premium support
2,500 executions/month, 5 concurrent executions, 1 shared project, unlimited users/workflows, 2,300 AI credits/month
10,000 executions/month, 20 concurrent executions, 3 shared projects, 7-day insights, up to 13,700 AI credits/month
Custom execution volume, 200+ concurrent executions, unlimited shared projects, dedicated SLA support, 365-day insights

cautions.en: Cloud plans are priced and billed in euros and cap monthly workflow executions; the free tier is self-hosted only, so anyone wanting a managed cloud instance must move to a paid plan.

capabilities.en: Visual workflow builder that mixes drag-and-drop nodes with custom JavaScript/Python code for complex logic
500+ pre-built integration nodes plus generic HTTP/API nodes for anything not natively supported
AI agent building with visibility into agent reasoning on the workflow canvas, and human-in-the-loop approval steps
Flexible deployment: self-hosted on-premise/air-gapped via Docker, or managed n8n Cloud

limitations.en: Cloud plans cap monthly workflow executions (2,500 on Starter), which can be exhausted quickly on high-volume automations
Enterprise governance features (RBAC, SSO, SAML) are reserved for higher tiers, not available on Starter/Pro

reason.en: The most direct mainstream competitor for no-code workflow automation, more polished but pricier at volume.
Visual automation builder with a similar node-based canvas, closer in pricing philosophy to n8n.
Another open-source workflow automation tool competing directly with n8n's self-hosted model.
Budget no-code automation alternative with lifetime-deal pricing, appealing to the same cost-conscious audience.

unknowns: Standalone (non-annual) monthly billing price for cloud plans not confirmed on the page fetched (annual figures shown)
Business plan is listed as cloud-pending/waitlist only, so its actual availability and final price are unconfirmed
